# axm context

Manage context package extensions.

## When to use

Use this command family when installing or publishing reusable files and project context.

## Usage

```bash
axm context <subcommand> [flags]
```

## Arguments

None.

## Flags

None.

Global flags are documented on [Global flags](./global-flags).

## Examples

**Install a context package**

```bash
axm context install @acme/context/workspace-baseline
```

## Subcommands

| Command                                         | Summary                                                      |
| ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| [axm context install](#axm-context-install)     | Install context packages                                     |
| [axm context uninstall](#axm-context-uninstall) | Uninstall a context package                                  |
| [axm context list](#axm-context-list)           | List installed context packages                              |
| [axm context enable](#axm-context-enable)       | Enable a context package                                     |
| [axm context disable](#axm-context-disable)     | Disable a context package without removing sync-once targets |
| [axm context update](#axm-context-update)       | Update configured context packages                           |
| [axm context new](#axm-context-new)             | Scaffold a new context package                               |
| [axm context publish](#axm-context-publish)     | Publish a context package                                    |
| [axm context prune](#axm-context-prune)         | Prune stale context lock entries                             |

### axm context install

Install context packages

```bash
axm context install [flags] [<source>]
```

### axm context uninstall

Uninstall a context package

```bash
axm context uninstall [flags] <name>
```

### axm context list

List installed context packages

```bash
axm context list [flags]
```

### axm context enable

Enable a context package

```bash
axm context enable [flags] <name>
```

### axm context disable

Disable a context package without removing sync-once targets

```bash
axm context disable [flags] <name>
```

### axm context update

Update configured context packages

```bash
axm context update [flags]
```

### axm context new

Scaffold a new context package

```bash
axm context new [flags] <name>
```

### axm context publish

Publish a context package

```bash
axm context publish [flags] <input>
```

### axm context prune

Prune stale context lock entries

```bash
axm context prune [flags]
```

## Requirements

- workspace

## Side effects

None.
